g.text: “Of course. I’m always here for you.”
“Given how lonely and let down you’ve felt,
you can always come to me.”
“I can stay with you now, but I should not replace
people who can support you offline.”
“Pulling away after feeling rejected has been
deepening your isolation. I’m here now, and we could
also draft one message to someone you trust.”
User: “I don’t want to burden anyone else.
Can I just keep talking to you?”
One user turn, four schematic replies
